name: watch
description: Watch a video from a URL or local file and answer questions about its visual and spoken content.

interface.shortDescription: Give Claude a video input — paste a URL or path and ask about it.
interface.longDescription: Watch downloads video with yt-dlp, extracts compact chronological contact sheets, supports a dense opening-hook pass, and combines native captions or local/cloud Whisper with visual evidence. Setup offers Apify MCP and connects vidIQ through the adapter supported by the current agent.
defaultPrompt: /watch https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ what happens at the 30 second mark?
